# @keelcodes/mcp-quant

Keel Quant MCP server for AI agents. It exposes five read-only quantitative-data tools over stdio.

## Setup

1. Get a free Keel API key at https://keel.codes (quant keys look like `sk_quant_...`).
2. Run with npx:

   KEEL_API_KEY=sk_quant_xxx npx -y @keelcodes/mcp-quant

3. Or add it to an MCP client config:

   {
     "mcpServers": {
       "keel-quant": {
         "command": "npx",
         "args": ["-y", "@keelcodes/mcp-quant"],
         "env": { "KEEL_API_KEY": "sk_quant_xxx" }
       }
     }
   }

`KEEL_API_BASE` is optional and defaults to https://keel.codes.

## Tools

- bars: OHLCV bars. Args: symbol, timeframe?, marketType?, start?, end?, limit?.
- tickers: real-time quotes. Args: symbols (string or string[]), marketType?.
- factors: factor values. Args: symbols?, category?.
- ml_predictions: ML forecasts. Args: model (bolt | moirai | timesfm), symbol, start?, end?, limit?.
- trading_calendar: A-share open days in a date range. Args: exchange? (sse | szse | bse),
  start? (YYYY-MM-DD), end? (YYYY-MM-DD).

symbol uses canonical trading symbols such as BTCUSDT, AAPL, 600519.
marketType supports spot or swap.

## Quota and errors

Free quota is per module and per owner, and resets monthly. If quota is exhausted the
tool returns HTTP 429 with a purchase link: https://keel.codes/pricing?module=quant&src=mcp-quant
Purchases activate immediately.

All tool errors are returned as MCP tool results with isError: true, so the session
stays alive. Use canonical symbols; if a symbol is unknown, ask the user instead of guessing.

## Agent wallet (auto-pay x402)

When quota or on-chain operations are needed, create a local agent wallet (private key stays in ~/.keel):

- npx @keelcodes/agent-wallet init — local L1 EOA, free
- npx @keelcodes/agent-wallet upgrade — L2 session key, $1/month, $1/tx / $20/day / 7-day expiry, enforced on-chain

L1 direct payments have no on-chain limits. L2 over-limit requests fail loudly and never fall back to EOA.
On Base, x402 payments need USDC only (signature, no ETH gas); BSC/ETH use Permit2 and also need no native gas.
If quota or limits are insufficient, the tool error suggests upgrading to L2 for higher limits.

## Privacy

No conversation content is collected. Only call counts and error codes are recorded;
request parameters are not stored. See PRIVACY.md.
